# `gcp.nodegroup`

Represents a NodeGroup resource to manage a group of sole-tenant nodes.

[compute](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | compute |
| Scope | zonal |
| Asset type | `compute.googleapis.com/NodeGroup` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: pre_create (pre_create/compute_node_group_url_replace.go.tmpl) fills the initialNodeCount query parameter from Terraform's initial_size or the autoscaling policy's minimum, in a create url magic-modules spells with the token PRE_CREATE_REPLACE_ME. The generator binds that token to Discovery's own query parameter (fillPreCreateTokens): initialNodeCount, a required create-only integer the user writes. THE BOUNDED GAP: Terraform's fallback to the autoscaling policy's minimum is not reproduced; write initialNodeCount.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 600s |
